title: Chapter 122 Planting Spies
content:
Chapter 122 Planting Spies

The next morning.

Wang Shuo quietly called Ladul and prepared to give him a secret mission.

The reason why he was chosen was that his loyalty had reached the maximum value.

Moreover, he had a lively personality, was good at making friends, and was suitable for gathering information outside.

To be on the safe side, Wang Shuo still planned to use a "Thought Stamp" scroll on him.

"Ladul, come and sit down."

Ladul was called over early in the morning. In Wang Shuo's tent, he was a little confused and looked at Wang Shuo in confusion.

Wang Shuo smiled and said, "Ladul, how do you feel in Wana Village these days?"

"Very good, although we have known each other for a short time, we feel like family."

"Yes, but this world is too dangerous. If we want to protect our family, without strong strength and accurate intelligence, we will be killed by wild beasts sooner or later and bullied by other lords!"

Ladul was suddenly startled when he heard this. The lord was saying something!

Then, he said to Wang Shuo seriously: "Lord, as long as you can use me, just speak up."

I've been waiting for you to say this!

"Okay, I admire your courage very much." Wang Shuo laughed, and suddenly lowered his voice, approached Radul and said, "I have a secret mission here, and I need you to execute it."

Wang Shuo took out the "Spy Job Transfer Certificate".

After seeing it, Radul opened his mouth wide with an expression of disbelief.

"There is such a profession?"

[Spy Job Transfer Certificate: Hidden profession, after use, you can transform into a spy, hide your own territory attributes, and disguise your loyalty. 】

"Are you willing to become a spy and contribute your own strength to the future of our Wana Village?"

"It's really exciting, I like it." Radul agreed without thinking.

Okay, here is another contract, I hope you can understand.

Radul looked at the content on the "Thought Stamp" scroll, and there was no big conflict with his inner thoughts at this time.

After all, it was 100 points of loyalty, and he quickly agreed to Wang Shuo's request.

Wang Shuo originally thought that if he wanted Ladul to be an undercover agent, he would have to do some ideological work himself, but he didn't expect it to be so smooth.

In order to improve his strength, Wang Shuo also prepared a purple spirit flower and an agility enhancement pill for him.

A set of yellow-level exercises, horse cards, and a number of energy crystals and gold coins as start-up funds.

As a spy, the ability to escape must be strong enough, and agility can greatly improve the speed of movement, which is the most suitable.

After Ladul walked out, a resident named Wang Bao soon came to Wang Shuo's tent.

Wang Shuo also persuaded him with reason and emotion, and finally convinced him to change his job to a spy.

Then Guan Jie, Zhang Yu, Si Xinyi and other three people also entered Wang Shuo's tent one by one.

Wang Shuo gave each of them the same supplies and left a contact code.

"Heavenly King Covering Earth Tiger, I fuck your mother."

In the future, if Wang Shuo doesn't contact them himself, this code will be needed.

At breakfast, the resident never saw these people again.

From now on, they will hide in the dark and contribute their strength to the development of Wana Village silently.

After breakfast, Wang Shuo found Ayub.

"Lord." Ayub saluted Wang Shuo respectfully.

"Well, not bad, not bad." After the baptism of battle, Ayub's level has reached level 26.

Wang Shuo took out the legion order and the formation experience of "One Word Long Snake Formation" and gave it to him.

"What is this?" Ayub took these two things, his pupils suddenly dilated, and he could not hide his excitement.
